description: This file contains tests for the Mattermost server configuration file store, including creation, loading, environment variable overrides, setting configurations, and file operations.

methods.name: setupConfigFile
methods.description: Creates a temporary configuration file with optional initial config data for testing.

methods.name: setupConfigFileStore
methods.description: Sets up a configuration store backed by a file for testing.

methods.name: getActualFileConfig
methods.description: Reads and decodes the configuration from a file without using the config store.

methods.name: assertFileEqualsConfig
methods.description: Asserts that the on-disk config matches the expected config.

methods.name: assertFileNotEqualsConfig
methods.description: Asserts that the on-disk config does not match the expected config.

methods.name: wasCalled
methods.description: Checks if a callback channel was called within a specified duration.
